referenceRoles: Four provided pixel-art sheets were inspected as visual references; all output characters are original.

characters.desc: Ravik, an adult male demon with violet skin, angular masculine features, swept violet horns, dark tousled hair, black/navy tailored magitech coat with fitted industrial belts and small magenta accents, heavy black boots, glowing magenta energy sword. Portrait looks composed and formidable. A humanoid male demon, no wings.
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original TownGrid video game pixel sprite atlas with an illustrated character portrait.
Create a landscape 1536x1024 pixel PNG with a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Every visible mark is deliberate hard-edged pixel art. No lettering, numbers, labels, watermark, lines, panels, ground, checkerboard or shadows.
STYLE: Beautiful detailed crisp dot-pixel RPG art, dark thin outlines, restrained coordinated palette, 1990s Japanese pixel adventure quality, fantasy mixed with modern industrial clothing. Not 3D, voxel, vector or smooth painted. Full-body mini sprites have small adult humanoid proportions about 3.5 heads high. Portrait and mini sprites depict one consistent original character.
LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: portrait and exactly 64 mini sprites. LEFT THIRD x=0..511 contains ONLY one large detailed thigh-up portrait, contained in x=24..488 and y=24..1000, head and hair fully inside. RIGHT TWO THIRDS x=512..1535 contains exactly 8 columns and exactly 8 rows of mini full-body figures, one figure per 128x128 invisible cell. Cell centers x=576,704,832,960,1088,1216,1344,1472. Row feet baselines y=116,244,372,500,628,756,884,1012. Keep all pixels, weapons, ears, tails and cargo within their own cell with at least 12 px margins. Body height approximately 92 px, consistent across all 64 frames.
DIRECTION ROWS top to bottom (MUST BE EIGHT DISTINCT DIRECTIONS): row 1 SOUTH facing front toward viewer; row 2 SOUTHWEST diagonal front facing down-left; row 3 WEST true left profile; row 4 NORTHWEST diagonal back facing up-left; row 5 NORTH full back view away from viewer; row 6 NORTHEAST diagonal back facing up-right; row 7 EAST true right profile; row 8 SOUTHEAST diagonal front facing down-right. True side and back artwork, not front-facing duplicates.
ACTION COLUMNS left to right: column 1 idle; column 2 walking left foot extended; column 3 walking passing feet; column 4 walking right foot extended; column 5 walking carrying a small wooden supply box with left foot extended; column 6 walking carrying the same box with right foot extended; column 7 attack windup with weapon raised; column 8 attack contact with visible weapon swing and body follow-through. Walking poses visibly differ. Carry-box frames really hold a clearly visible little wooden box, with weapon stowed. Attacks have visibly different windup and contact poses. Clothes, hair, face, body and palette match portrait.
Use all eight rows and all eight columns, regular spacing, no overflow. Artwork is isolated on actual transparency.
CHARACTER: Ravik, an adult male demon with violet skin, angular masculine features, swept violet horns, dark tousled hair, black/navy tailored magitech coat with fitted industrial belts and small magenta accents, heavy black boots, glowing magenta energy sword. Portrait looks composed and formidable. A humanoid male demon, no wings.

Weapon is a compact massive wrench-club. Match his broad build across all sprites.
